headline: GTA 6 Online may not launch alongside the main game.
body: GTA 6 Online may not launch alongside the main game. According to Forbes, Rockstar’s next multiplayer experience could arrive 1–2 years after GTA 6 releases on November 19. Rockstar Games has still not officially revealed its plans for GTA 6 Online or confirmed when multiplayer will be available, so for now, players may be looking at a single-player-focused launch. If the report is accurate, it would mean Rockstar is giving the story mode plenty of time in the spotlight before introducing the next generation of GTA Online. Would you be okay waiting 1–2 years for GTA 6 Online?
